 Analytics & Information Management

AIM is a global community that is driving data driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world.

Client Remediation Analytics

The Client Remediation – Data Analyst, accomplishes results through the management of professional team that Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Indirect responsibility of a cross-functional team to identify and validate client population analytics for issues requiring client remediation and remuneration.


Data/Information Mgt Int Analyst


The Data/Information Mgt Int Analyst is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the sub function/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

Responsibilities:


CRX team manages the analysis of the customer remediation issues for NAM Lines of Business - USCC . The critical areas of work are :

Remediation analysis: Execution of the comprehensive data remediation approach on Customer issues due to gaps observed in policies and governance, Self-identified, or through IA.Impact assessment: Identification of size of the customers and the dollar amount impacted due to these issues.Issue Management & Root cause analysis: Identifying the issues and reasons for the issues by leveraging analytical methods.Audit Support: Tracking implementation plans and providing data evidence, artifacts for audit completion.Daily deliverable of routine and defined outputs, while at the same time developing knowledge of the broader context in which the work is being performed.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications:


At least 5-8 years relevant experienceAbility to think strategically and the ability to engage resources outside of their direct control to achieve objectivesKnow-how on analytic tools (SAS E-miner, Knowledge Seeker, SPSS etc.)Big data and machine learning experiences are (R, Python etc.) a plus
Tools and Platforms:


Business Analysis, Requirement Gathering, Data AnalysisExposure in SAS, SQL, RDBMSProficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and VBAJira, Bitbucket
Domain Skills:


Good understanding of banking domain and consumer products (cards, Retail Banking, Deposit, Loans, Wealth management, Mortgage, Insurance, etc.) is preferred.
Other Info:


Education Level: Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience/ Engineering/ MBA from a premier instituteOverall experience of 5-8 years with experience in Data Analyst role.Experience in Banking Industry is a plus.Job Category: Decision ManagementSchedule: Full-timeWorking days: Hybrid - Minimum 3 days in office in a week (adherence to CITI HWW policy)Shift: Regular Local Working Hours (aligned with NAM overlapping working hours)

jobs.title: SQL Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Applications are open for the SQL Data Analyst position at AMD India in Bengaluru. You will join a working data analytics team, own a defined set of reports and analyses end to end, and see your findings turn into decisions that people act on.

About the role
The SQL Data Analyst at AMD India is the bridge between the data and the decision. Your work centres on writing the SQL that extracts, models and validates business data using SQL and relational databases, and on making sure that everyone reading your numbers understands what they mean and how far they can be trusted.

Key responsibilities
• Write, optimise and document SQL for analysis and reporting
• Model and join data across many source tables reliably
• Build the curated datasets that feed dashboards
• Reconcile query output against source systems before publishing
• Support ad-hoc data requests with fast, correct answers
• Validate and reconcile numbers before they are published, and document known data caveats
• Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on analysis rather than refreshes
• Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, plain language

Required skills and tools
• SQL
• Query Optimisation
• Joins & Window Functions
• Stored Procedures
• Data Modelling
• Advanced Excel
• Power BI
• Data Validation
• ETL Concepts
• Indexing Basics
• Analytical Thinking
• Documentation

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree. Candidates from any recognised university are welcome.
• Graduation year: 2023–2026 batches. Freshers and final-year students awaiting results may apply.
• Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA in the highest qualification (indicative — strong practical skills can offset this).
• Experience: 0–3 years in analytics, reporting, MIS or a closely related function.
• Technical skills: SQL, Query Optimisation, Joins & Window Functions, Stored Procedures, Data Modelling, Advanced Excel.
• Soft skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, stakeholder communication, ownership and the confidence to flag a number that looks wrong.

Salary and compensation
• Annual CTC: ₹4,90,000 – ₹11,00,000 per year (4.9 LPA – 11 LPA), an indicative market range for this role in Bengaluru.
• Monthly equivalent: approximately ₹66,000 per month at the mid-point of the range.
• Currency: INR (₹).
• Performance bonus / variable pay as per AMD India's policy, reviewed annually.
• The exact offer is confirmed by AMD India based on your interview performance and current compensation.

Perks and benefits
• Health insurance for you and your dependants
• Provident Fund and statutory benefits
• Structured onboarding and mentorship
• Learning & certification support (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, cloud)
• Paid leaves and public holidays
• Flexible / hybrid working options
• Modern analytics tooling and licensed BI seats
• Clear appraisal cycle and internal mobility

Location, work mode and employment type
• Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
• Work mode: Work From Office
• Employment type: Full-time, permanent
• Working hours: Standard business hours, Monday to Friday (5-day week)
• Number of openings: 5
• Joining: immediate to 60 days, as per your notice period

Selection process
• Round 1 — Resume screening and profile shortlisting by the talent acquisition team
• Round 2 — Case study / take-home assignment on a real dataset, with a walkthrough of your approach
• Round 3 — Technical interview 2 — BI tooling, dashboard design and metric definition
• Round 4 — Business / stakeholder round — how you scope a question and communicate findings
• Round 5 — HR discussion — compensation, notice period, joining date and offer roll-out

Who should apply
Candidates from B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree with up to 3 years of relevant experience who are based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate. You should be comfortable with SQL, Query Optimisation, Joins & Window Functions and able to explain your analysis to someone who has never seen the data. Portfolio projects, Kaggle work, a GitHub repo or published dashboards strengthen an application, especially for early-career candidates.

Why join AMD India
AMD India invests in its analytics people — structured onboarding, mentorship from senior analysts, certification support and a clear path from analyst to senior analyst and beyond. High performers move into senior and lead analyst roles, take ownership of a business vertical, or specialise in data science, data engineering or product analytics. You will leave every year of this role with the query layer every dashboard in your team is built on.

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not signed in you will be asked to log in or create a free MyInternships.in candidate account first, after which you will be taken directly to AMD India's official careers page to submit your application. Applications close on 20 September 2026 and are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Additional information
• Documents required at the interview stage: updated resume, degree certificates or provisional certificate, and government photo ID.
• Experienced candidates should also carry recent payslips and a relieving or experience letter.
• There is no service bond for this position, and no equipment deposit is taken.
• A laptop and licensed analytics tooling are provided by AMD India for office and hybrid roles.
• AMD India and MyInternships.in never charge a fee at any stage of the application, selection or onboarding process. If anyone asks you for money in the name of this job, do not pay — report it. Responsibilities: Write, optimise and document SQL for analysis and reporting; Model and join data across many source tables reliably; Build the curated datasets that feed dashboards; Reconcile query output against source systems before publishing; Support ad-hoc data requests with fast, correct answers; Validate and reconcile numbers before publishing, and document data caveats; Automate recurring reporting to free up time for real analysis; Present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Requirements: B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree from a recognised university; 0–3 years of experience in analytics, reporting or MIS — freshers and 2026 graduates are welcome; Working knowledge of SQL, Query Optimisation, Joins & Window Functions; Comfort with SQL and relational databases and with cleaning messy, real-world data; Ability to define a metric precisely and explain a result to a non-technical stakeholder; Attention to detail, ownership and the discipline to document your work; Based in Bengaluru, Karnataka or willing to relocate.
